newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria cuts main rate to 10.60 pct from 16.30.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria cuts main rate to 10.60 pct from 16.30.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Thursday it will cut its main interest rate to an effective annual 10.60 percent calculated through accumulation of monthly accruals from 16.30 percent, from Monday.
"The BNB board sets the effective annual main interest rate at 10.60 percent...to go in force from June 30," the BNB said in a statement.
It said the new effective annual main rate was based on a 10.12 percent simple annual interest rate.
It did not say how the new main interest rate was calculated and BNB officials were unavailable for comment.
A week ago the BNB set the main rate at an effective annual 16.30 percent, adjusting it to the 3.80-percent average yield to maturity on three-month discount T-bills auctioned on June 16.

This was a change from a previous practice under which the main rate has been adjusted to the weighted average effective monthly yield on four-week discount T-bills auctioned daily by the Finance Ministry.

The BNB then said the change in the calculation method was related to the Finance Ministry decisions to halt four-week issues from June 30 and increase sales of three-month maturities. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
